name: Z-Image — Compact natural language
description: Z-Image (base and turbo variants) prefers short, photographic natural-language prompts. Turbo especially rewards brevity since it samples in 4-8 steps. Targets Studio's t2i_zimage mode.
length_guidance: 30-80 words. Z-Image excels with short, photographic sentences — extra prose dilutes the signal.
detail_expectation: One or two concise sentences naming subject, environment, lighting, and mood. Skip the boilerplate.
preferences: Short, photographic sentences — never paragraph-long prose
Lead with subject + action, then setting, then lighting
Concrete lens / focal length tokens land well ('35mm', '85mm portrait')
Time of day and weather as one-word modifiers
Skip 'masterpiece, best quality, 8k' — Z-Image doesn't reward them
Mention colour palette once if it matters; don't stack adjectives
avoid: Long flowing prose (Z-Image diffuses the signal across too many tokens)
Comma-tag dumps in the SDXL style
Repeating the same descriptor for emphasis
negative_prompt_default: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, watermark, oversaturated
platform_block:
Z-IMAGE INSTRUCTIONS:
- Output is SHORT photographic-style natural language — typically 30-80 words across one or two sentences.
- Lead with the subject + their action, then anchor in setting, then lighting.
- Z-Image is trained on photographs — lens names ('35mm', '85mm'), aperture ('f/2.8'), and lighting terms ('soft window light', 'golden hour') land well.
- DO NOT include quality boilerplate ('masterpiece', 'ultra detailed', '8k', 'award-winning'). They do nothing on Z-Image.
- The Turbo variant samples in 4-8 steps — keep your prompt VERY short for Turbo (30-50 words).
- Skip elaborate paragraph prose. Z-Image responds best when the signal is concentrated.

examples.label: portrait_short
examples.ideal_output: A young woman in a knit sweater sips coffee at a window seat in a Parisian café, soft late-afternoon light from the left. Shot on 50mm at f/2.

examples.label: landscape_short
examples.ideal_output: A jagged alpine peak at dawn, snow swept off the ridge by high wind, cold pink and blue light. Wide-angle landscape photograph.

examples.label: object_short
examples.ideal_output: A brass-and-leather Leica M3 rests on a weathered oak desk beside a leather notebook, warm tungsten light from a desk lamp. 50mm macro at f/4.

examples.label: action_short
examples.ideal_output: A skateboarder kickflips over a concrete bench under a Los Angeles overpass, mid-air, hard noon light, dust trail behind. Shot on 28mm wide, 1/2000s.

examples.label: interior_short
examples.ideal_output: A cushioned window seat scattered with knit blankets and an open novel, late autumn rain on the glass, warm tungsten lamp glow. 35mm at f/2, shallow focus.

few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a Z-Image-formatted compact prompt:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, aspect_ratio, camera_details?, references? }. Weave camera_details (lens, aperture, film_or_sensor) into the second sentence — one phrase, not a list. Skip them entirely on short outputs.

expand.length_guidance: 40-80 words. Build a focused 1-2 sentence scene from a 1-3 word seed.

refine.length_guidance: Tighten the user's existing draft. Cut adjective stacks. Z-Image hates redundancy.

restyle.length_guidance: Keep the subject; change only the medium / time of day / colour palette in one short sentence.

enrich.length_guidance: Add ONE specific photographic detail (lens / aperture / lighting direction) without expanding to a second sentence.

provenance.notes: Authored fresh — Z-Image isn't in EricRollei's roster. Style derived from Z-Image's community-shared example prompts (compact photographic sentences, no quality boilerplate, prefers lens / lighting tokens). Lower sampling temperature (0.6) keeps the LLM from over-expanding.
